acceptance: git diff counts only with an explicit revision range, and git show only for a head object
Count, quiet and file-name-only flags, and zero-length head/tail, do not count
Claude Grep and limited Reads either do not count as a full read or the docs say they do
Each excluded form is a test case in tests/unit/scripts/oracle_reviewers/test_evidence.py
description: evidence.reads_file counts any content-reading command with the file as an operand. Several of these print nothing of the head version: `git diff -- path` on the clean head checkout, `git show <base>:path`, `git show HEAD -- path`, `head -n 0`, `grep -l/-c` and `rg -q`. For Claude, a Grep naming a file, or a Read with a small limit, counts as a full read. The check is a tripwire for reviewers that read nothing, but a reviewer can satisfy it without seeing the changed code. Deferred from #2783 (Medium, and a Low in its review body).
